}}'''Niko Tokama''' is a scientist, inventor, and a member of the [[School of Cairhien|Academy of Cairhien]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Niko Tokama}}

==Activities==
When [[Rand al'Thor]] visits the School of Cairhien with [[Min Farshaw]] in {{ne|1000}}, [[Idrien Tarsin]] tells him of Niko. According to Mistress Tarsin, Niko is working on a "silly" project.{{ref/book|9|prologue}}
